content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

The infrastructure behind GitHub Pages serves as a powerful solution for digital creators looking to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and more in markets often neglected by conventional payment platforms. By utilizing GitHub Pages, creators can host their stores for free, avoiding the high fees charged by platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10% from every sale. With NOWPayments charging only 0.5%, the potential savings for creators are substantial. This architecture not only empowers creators with full ownership of their digital products but also provides a reliable method for generating revenue in challenging financial environments.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core architecture leverages free hosting services like GitHub Pages, combined with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend automation. This setup allows creators to manage orders, process payments, and deliver products without relying on third-party platforms. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the crypto payment and automatically triggers the delivery of the digital product. This streamlined process ensures that creators maintain control over their transactions while benefiting from immediate delivery. The result is an efficient, cost-effective, and sovereign commerce solution tailored for digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in emerging markets where traditional payment platforms fall short. Whether you're selling ebooks, templates, or digital courses, this architecture provides the necessary tools to build a sustainable online store. It's perfect for individuals in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions where financial isolation is a reality. By adopting this infrastructure, creators are not only circumventing platform restrictions but also embracing a more resilient way to monetize their digital creations.
Avoid high fees: NOWPayments charges only 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this infrastructure include GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. Together, these tools create a cohesive system that allows creators to sell their products without incurring hefty fees. The integration of these components ensures that creators can manage their stores efficiently while maintaining full ownership of their data and products. This architecture empowers users to operate independently, free from the constraints of conventional e-commerce platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your own digital product store, first, create a GitHub account and set up GitHub Pages for free hosting. Next, use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order management and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions seamlessly. You can load your products into the system and configure your store within 48 hours. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints and templates to launch your store effectively. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Full ownership: You retain control over your store without any platform dependencies.

For those looking to build a comprehensive digital sales infrastructure, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything needed to deploy your own store. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up a store on GitHub Pages and automating transactions with NOWPayments. This approach eliminates reliance on high-fee platforms.

You can automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which trigger file delivery once payment is confirmed through NOWPayments.

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, enabling flexibility and lower transaction fees compared to traditional payment systems.
